problem: Production commercial runtime had canonical v1 orchestration but retained legacy v2-v6 function bodies, historical terminal actions without explicit lifecycle lineage, and repository drift versus the applied Supabase state.
root_cause: runtime evolution created compatibility versions without a permanent alias-only regression invariant
terminal action lifecycle and observed business outcomes were conflated in assurance
production migration state could advance before repository writeback became terminal
decision: Use one canonical commercial loop owner, turn legacy versions into aliases, enforce explicit terminal lineage without synthesising business outcomes, keep unresolved observed-outcome obligations open, and gate the invariant in Required test.
next_decision_rule: Any future change that creates a second full-loop scheduler owner, independent legacy loop logic, or a terminal action without lineage must fail CI and runtime regression before terminal completion can be claimed.
